description: Scaleway Generative APIs provides OpenAI-compatible Chat, Responses, embeddings, rerank, transcription and asynchronous Batch APIs hosted in Paris.
regional_pricing_notes: Scaleway publishes Generative APIs pricing in EUR on its public Generative APIs pricing section.
prompt_training_notes: Scaleway says Generative APIs apply Zero Data Retention by default, do not collect or reuse input/output content, and do not use it for model training; anonymized usage data may still be collected.

sources.notes: Scaleway Generative APIs documentation states default zero data retention and no collection, reuse, or training on request content; anonymized usage data may still be collected.
